# Official GitHub runner startup fixtures

Unmodified, never executed by these tests, from the observed Production
runner release v2.337.0:

- https://github.com/actions/runner/blob/v2.337.0/src/Misc/layoutbin/runsvc.sh
- https://github.com/actions/runner/blob/v2.337.0/src/Misc/layoutbin/RunnerService.js

The adjacent MIT license is retained. SHA-256 fingerprints in the read-only
boot collector reject changed scripts; a future script change requires review.
The tests use synthetic registration placeholders and never real credentials.
